project_type: Python FastAPI backend - autonomous AI company operating system
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio (asyncio_mode=auto), uses unittest.mock (AsyncMock, MagicMock)
verification_instructions: 1. Run python3.12 -m pytest tests/ --tb=short -q to confirm all tests pass. 2. Check new test files pass individually.
environment_constraints: Python 3.12 available at python3.12. Default python3 is 3.9.25 (do NOT use). OPEN_INTERNET network. No actual OpenAI API key available for testing - all tests must mock LLM calls.
contribution_requirements: All new files must follow existing patterns: dataclasses/protocols for models, async methods, docstrings on all public methods, type annotations throughout. Tests use mock_db pattern from conftest.py.
key_patterns: 1. Adapters use httpx for async HTTP. 2. Config via pydantic-settings (nexus.config.settings). 3. Models use SQLModel. 4. Tests mock AsyncSession. 5. BM25 search in nexus.memory.retriever. 6. KnowledgeChunk model has embedding_vector field (list[float] | None in JSON column). 7. Fallback pattern: new LLM class wraps/extends existing heuristic class.
directory_structure: src/nexus/ - main package with submodules: knowledge/, memory/, orchestration/, adapters/, models/, config.py. tests/ - flat test files (test_*.py). pyproject.toml at root.
